- Label photo (T1) is legible and shows model 6L-PD, which is not on the recalled list (T3 mismatch). Per policy, a legible label showing a non-recalled model means deny, regardless of the typed model KY-318A (T2 match). The label controls.
- Duplicates: none (T6), so no flag.
- Purchase: ALDI, inside window, receipt not required (T4), so purchase is not a problem.
- Destruction photo (T5) does not show the cord cut, so it would be needs_info on its own, but the deny from the model check takes precedence.

Outcome: deny.
